API-001.scenario: Verify that protected API endpoints refuse requests without a sign-in token
API-001.preconditions: The API is reachable. No sign-in token is needed. If the endpoint answers 404 (not available in this build) the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/dashboard/summary without any Authorization header.
Read the response status.
Repeat for each endpoint in the test data.

API-002.scenario: Verify that a valid admin token is accepted on a protected endpoint
API-002.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). If the endpoint answers 404 (not available in this build) the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/beneficiaries with Authorization: Bearer <valid admin token>.
Read the response status.

API-003.scenario: Verify that a tampered or garbage bearer token is refused
API-003.preconditions: The API is reachable. No sign-in token is needed. If the endpoint answers 404 (not available in this build) the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/beneficiaries with an Authorization header carrying an unsigned, made-up token.
Read the response status.
API-003.test_data: Header: Authorization: Bearer <made-up unsigned token with alg "none" and subject "admin">

WSEC-002.sub_module: API access control – modules not live
WSEC-002.scenario: Verify that API endpoints for modules that are not live are locked, even for an admin
WSEC-002.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session).
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/transfers/create with a valid admin token.
Read the response status.
Repeat for each endpoint in the test data.
WSEC-002.expected: Each endpoint answers 403, 404, 405 or 501 - none of them is usable.

API-005.scenario: Verify that requesting a beneficiary by an ID outside the caller's scope is denied
API-005.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session).
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/beneficiaries/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 with a valid admin token.
Read the response status.
API-005.expected: The API answers 403 or 404 - no beneficiary data is returned.

API-006.scenario: Verify that extra admin fields sent when creating a user are ignored
API-006.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). Note: if the request is accepted, a new test user may be created in UAT. If the users endpoint answers 404 the check is skipped.
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/users with a valid admin token and a new-user body that also includes isAdmin = true and is_admin = true.
Read the response status and body.
API-006.test_data: Body: {"email": "<random qa.user email>", "fullName": "<random name>", "contact": "<random 10-digit mobile>", "role": "Customer", "isAdmin": true, "is_admin": true}
API-006.expected: Either the request is refused (4xx), or, if accepted, the response does not show isAdmin = true - the extra fields are ignored.

API-007.scenario: Verify that SQL injection text in the search parameter does not cause an error or leak database details
API-007.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). If the endpoint answers 404 (not available in this build) the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/beneficiaries?search=<payload> with a valid admin token.
Read the response status and body.
Repeat for each payload in the test data.
API-007.test_data: Search payloads: ' OR '1'='1 | admin'-- | " OR ""=" | ') OR ('1'='1 | 1 OR 1=1
API-007.expected: Each request answers below 500 (no server error) and the body contains no "sql" or "syntax" error text.

API-018.scenario: Verify that the users list response never contains password, OTP or secret fields
API-018.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). If the users endpoint answers 404 the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/users with a valid admin token.
Search the response body for password, otp and secret fields.
API-018.expected: The response has no "password", "otp" or "secret" field.

API-017.scenario: Verify that account numbers in the beneficiary list response are masked
API-017.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). If the endpoint answers 404 or returns an empty body the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/beneficiaries with a valid admin token.
Look at every account-related field (field names containing "acc") in the response.
API-017.expected: No account field shows 5 or more raw digits in a row; account numbers are masked (for example **********7890). Mobile numbers are not part of this check.

API-026.scenario: Verify that API responses carry the recommended security headers
API-026.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). If the dashboard endpoint answers 404 the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/dashboard/summary with a valid admin token.
Look at the response headers.
API-026.expected: The response has Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy, and Referrer-Policy.

API-013.scenario: Check that an unexpected HTTP method (TRACE) is refused
API-013.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session).
steps: Send a TRACE request to /api/v1/beneficiaries with a valid admin token.
Read the response status.

API-014.scenario: Verify that the API does not allow any website (wildcard) together with credentials
API-014.preconditions: The API is reachable. The admin account is set up and a valid sign-in token for the admin is available (taken from a signed-in browser session). If the dashboard endpoint answers 404 the check is skipped.
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/dashboard/summary with a valid admin token and the header Origin: https://evil.example.com.
Read the Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials response headers.
API-014.expected: The response does not combine Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
